name: Everything Blockchain, Inc.
summary: Everything Blockchain, Inc. specializes in offering advisory services and developing advanced solutions within the blockchain and cybersecurity sectors. Their product line features EB Control, a robust zero-trust data access system catering to both individual users and organizations, in addition to their EB Advise and EB Build offerings. Established in 2017, the company originally operated as ObitX, Inc. before officially rebranding to Everything Blockchain, Inc. in May 2021. Its corporate headquarters are located in Jacksonville, Florida.
